content: If UdpNm has entered Network mode or called Nm_CoordReadyToSleepCancellation before it shall notify the NM by calling Nm_ Coord ReadyTo Sleep Indication on the first reception of NM message with the NmCoordinatorSleepReady bit (see CBV ) set to 1
